body:
I can see how this being marked as an official vulnerability requires us to change the version of qs.

Note however that this has a 10k bundlesize penalty, and is the original reason why we added the limitation of not 6.10 of qs.

I've made PR https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch/pull/6850 to fix this. In the mean time you can force the resolution of qs to 6.14.1, it won't break InstantSearch.
